newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Pulkovo, Aer Lingus in link to US.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Pulkovo, Aer Lingus in link to US.

text.p: St Petersburg's Pulkovo Airlines will begin operating a weekly flight to Shannon airport, offering through-connections on Ireland's Aer Lingus to three U.S. destinations, a Pulkovo official said on Thursday.
The Russian state-owned airline will operate a Tupolev Tu-154 jet between St Petersburg, Russia's second city, and Shannon in western Ireland on Fridays, under a new agreement signed with Aer Lingus.
"Aer Lingus will carry passengers to New York, Chicago and Boston aboard its Airbus A330 aircraft," the official said.
Transit time at Shannon should be no more than an hour and a half.
